verses.text: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down; indeed, we wept When we remembered Zion.
On the willows in the midst of it We hung up our lyres,

verses.text: For there our captors required of us songs, And those who tormented us required of us mirth, saying, Sing for us One of the songs of Zion.

verses.text: How can we sing the song of Jehovah In a foreign land?
If I forget you, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget its skill.
Let my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth, If I do not remember you, If I do not prefer Jerusalem Above my chief joy.

verses.text: O daughter of Babylon, who are to be devastated, Happy will he be who repays you The recompense of what you have rendered to us.
